2027 Sample Reinvestment Grants

The office is seeking proposals for sample community projects that reduce justice involvement.

Read the RFP

Applications are due by 4:00 PM on December 2, 2026.

The maximum request is $150,000.

Eligible applicants are nonprofit organizations, Tribal Nations, and local units of government.

February 1, 2027, through December 31, 2028.
